desc: reject a task whose title duplicates an open task already in the space
usage: hook input JSON {kind, title, open_titles:["#<n> <title>", ...]}; prints 'ok' or 'reject duplicate of #<n>'

examples.in: {"kind":"task","title":"Fix the login bug","open_titles":["#12 fix the login bug"]}

tests.in_text: {"kind":"task","title":"Fix the login bug","open_titles":["#12 fix the login BUG!","#5 add logging"]}
{"kind":"task","title":"New feature X","open_titles":["#12 fix the login bug"]}
